actualNativeObservation.palette: Very dark brown-black ground; tangled thin grey-green/olive/yellow-ochre/brown strands.
actualNativeObservation.structure: Dense irregular short bending and crossing fibres with small interstices; no large band, joint, organized weave or perimeter.
actualNativeObservation.featureScale: Visual estimate of most strand bodies about 1-3 native pixels; not a botanical measurement. Native is ambiguous.

interpretation.chosenMaterial: Weathered matted dry grass and fine straw-like plant fibres over dark compact organic ground.
interpretation.finish: Matte; close packed, shallow overlapping stems/blades with natural tapered or split ends and fine longitudinal plant structure.
interpretation.inference: Strong upward-facing use is compatible with ground fibre litter; sloped/vertical use prevents an exclusive ground or roof claim. Chosen photographic material is an artistic interpretation, not identified historical species or thatch construction.
interpretation.usageLimits: Unique BSP-content face records; not area-weighted, not a runtime visibility/entity-transform proof. Orientation does not identify material.
mustAvoid: large straw bundles or roof courses

sourcePlan.provider: Existing built-in image tool only, after root approval and journal issue.

existingProductionRouteAfterApproval.profileMeaning: Existing numerical fine/mid-band shaping weights only; not a claim of timber. No profile/producer edits.
existingProductionRouteAfterApproval.landmarks: None proposed; no invented registration anchors on an all-over irregular mat.
existingProductionRouteAfterApproval.reliefIntent: Shallow overlapping rounded/flattened fibres over small gaps, without broad topographic colour steps. Dark pigment/old plant colour is not automatically a deep cavity; pale fibres are not automatically highest.
existingProductionRouteAfterApproval.reliefGate: Inspect actual source physical overlaps, independently sample visible fibre/gap relationships and inspect full-precision scalar + neutral opposed lights before tiers. Ordinary brightness-derived fit may fail. HOLD and obtain independent actual source/master proof before any existing guarded semantic repair if it fails; do not weaken gate.

qualificationPlan: View adequate actual raw: recognisable plant fibres without label; native coarse palette, density and scale preserved.
Inspect full-precision master RGB/scalar, actual semantic overlaps/gaps and neutral opposed lights before encoding; no perimeter relief.
Derive Mid and High directly from same retained full-precision RGB/scalar master.
Public review plus independent replay of input/tool hashes, finishing/craft math, direct codec outputs, HTML and content/label provenance.
Compare native and decoded diffuse using same BOX at native/2=32 and native/4=16.
Inspect literal both-axis joins, four corners and 2x2 repeat for colour and decoded height/XYZ; fixed neutral opposed lights at both tiers.
Require useful fibre geometry at both decoded resolutions without uniform synthetic grain, repeated stamps, deep cut scribbles or macro colour emboss.
